descriptionByLocale.it: Location: Hirslanden Corporate Office | Home-Office Hiring date: According to agreement Employment contract type: Unlimited Reference number: 71086 Our corporate strategy «Together We Care» is positioned to enable us to create added value for both the individual and society, now and in the future. Our purpose is always to improve the quality of life of the people who entrust themselves to our care. As a specialist Mergers & Acquisitions you will play a central role in shaping and executing the Group’s strategic growth agenda through high-impact transactions and partnerships. You will lead the identification, evaluation, and execution of buy-side and sell-side M&A opportunities, contributing directly to long-term value creation and strategic expansion. YOUR TASKS - Lead and support end-to-end M&A processes (buy-side and sell-side), including origination, execution, and closing - Build and maintain advanced financial models (DCF, trading/comparable multiples, and synergy-based valuation analyses) - Coordinate complex, cross-functional due diligence (financial, commercial, legal, and tax) - Prepare high-quality investment materials, including investment memoranda, board presentations, management decks, NBOs, BOs, and decision papers - Support transaction structuring, negotiations, and execution in collaboration with senior leadership and external advisors - Conduct in-depth market, industry, and competitive analyses to identify inorganic growth opportunities - Evaluate acquisition targets, partnerships, and divestment options aligned with corporate strategy - Support post-merger integration (PMI) activities, adhoc financial analysis, and financing initiatives YOUR PROFIL - University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field from a top-tier institution - 3+ years of experience in Investment Banking, M&A, Corporate Finance, or Transaction Advisory (Big 4 experience is a plus) - Strong financial modelling and valuation expertise with hands-on transaction execution experience - Solid understanding of M&A processes, due diligence frameworks, and deal structuring - Healthcare sector experience is a strong advantage - Fluent in English and French (business fluent); German is a plus - Strong analytical mindset with a structured, entrepreneurial, and results-oriented approach - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced, deal-driven environment Are you ready to get started in an innovative environment? With us, you can fully develop your strengths, expertise and skills. On your first day at work, we’ll give you a warm welcome and make sure you feel at home with us right from the start. You can start enjoying a whole host of benefits right from the very first week: - A varied menu in our staff canteen at a discounted price - Fitness 24/7: Free access to our gym (including lunchtime classes) - Free employee counselling: For your well-being – whether you have work-related questions, personal challenges, or simply want to gain a fresh perspective - More than 5 weeks’ holiday as part of our Leisure Plus programme – for the perfect work-life balance And you’ll find lots more exciting benefits here! For further information, please contact Franca Zanoni (Head of Mergers & Acquisitions) by email franca.zanoni@hirslanden.ch. Livia Camenisch looks forward to receiving your full online application. Please note that we cannot accept paper applications (which will not be returned) or applications sent by email. Please therefore apply online using this tool only. Mixed teams work better. We are proud of the experience of over 10,000 employees from more than 80 nations. Their knowledge and experience are our strength. Every day, we promote diversity, equal opportunities and equal pay for equal work. This is why we were named one of the "Leaders in Diversity" in the healthcare industry in Europe by the Financial Times in 2021.

• Offriamo a tutti gli individui, indipendentemente dalla loro situazione, assistenza medica individuale di alto livello per migliorare la loro qualità di vita - dalla nascita alla vecchiaia e dalla prevenzione alla cura. Come parte della nostra strategia aziendale Insieme Ci prendiamo cura, il nostro obiettivo ultimo è quello di migliorare la qualità della vita delle persone che si fidano di noi. TASK PRINCIPALI Si evolverà all'interno di un'unità operativa composta da 6 sale operatorie, con un vassoio tecnico all'avanguardia specializzato in chirurgia cardiaca. - Strumentazione nelle seguenti specialità: ginecologia/ostetrica, urologia, chirurgia cardiovascolare, chirurgia robotica, chirurgia viscerale, chirurgia bariatrica, neurochirurgia, chirurgia plastica e ricostruttiva e chirurgia toracica. TUO PROFILE - Diploma in allattamento con una specializzazione nel campo della chirurgia o del tecnico in una sala operatoria laureata con esperienza confermata - Per i diplomi stranieri, il riconoscimento del diploma da parte della Croce Rossa è obbligatorio (in corso o ottenuto) - Personalità dinamica, flessibile - Forte motivazione, alto senso di responsabilità e la capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con un team multidisciplinare in un servizio all'avanguardia - Capacità organizzativa e anticipazione WE OFFERTA Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro interessanti con, tra l'altro, opportunità di formazione continua e sviluppo durante la tua carriera con noi, così come i benefici sociali e altri benefici interessanti. Per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e vita privata, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti vari modelli contrattuali, inclusi contratti part-time e FLEXible. C'è anche la possibilità di godere fino a 7 settimane di vacanza grazie alla nostra offerta "Congé-Plus". Inoltre, i dipendenti che lavorano in uniforme sono concessi 4 giorni di ferie annue supplementari in proporzione al tempo di partecipazione. Vedi tutte le condizioni di lavoro e dei benefici dei dipendenti facendo clic sulle prestazioni dei dipendenti presso il Clinique Cecile Cecil Hirslanden Clinique Cecil LA TUA CANDIDATURE Alan Morel, HR Business Partner, è lieto di ricevere la tua candidatura completa (lettera di motivazione, curriculum vitae, copie dei tuoi diplomi e certificati). Si prega di notare che per motivi di protezione dei dati, non possiamo considerare i file di carta (che non saranno restituiti) o le applicazioni via e-mail. Pertanto, si prega di fare la vostra richiesta esclusivamente online tramite questo strumento.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Place of work: Hirslanden Clinique Cecile Cecile - Lausanne Job type: Indeterminate Reference Number: 64136 The Hirslanden Group is Switzerland's largest medical network.
• We offer all individuals, regardless of their situation, high-level individual medical care to improve their quality of life - from birth to old age and from prevention to cure. As part of our corporate strategy Together We Care, our ultimate goal is to improve the quality of life of people who trust us. MAIN TASKS You will evolve within an operating unit consisting of 6 operating rooms, with a state-of-the-art technical tray specialized in cardiac surgery. - Instrumentation in the following specialties: gynaecology/obstetrics, urology, cardiovascular surgery, robotic surgery, visceral surgery, bariatric surgery, neurosurgery, plastic and reconstructive surgery and chest surgery. YOUR PROFILE - Diploma in nursing with a specialisation in the field of surgery or technician in a graduate operating room with confirmed experience - For foreign diplomas, recognition of the diploma by the Red Cross is compulsory (in progress or obtained) - Dynamic personality, flexible - Strong motivation, high sense of responsibility and ability to work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team in a state-of-the-art service - Organizational capacity and anticipation WE OFFER YOU In addition to an attractive workstation in the heart of Lausanne, you will integrate a dynamic team that looks forward to welcoming you into a human-sized structure. You will benefit from attractive conditions of employment with, among other things, opportunities for continuing training and development throughout your career with us, as well as social benefits and other interesting benefits. For an optimal balance between work and private life, we offer our employees various contractual models, including part-time and FLEXible contracts. There is also the possibility to enjoy up to 7 weeks of holiday thanks to our offer "Congé-Plus". In addition, employees working in uniform shall be granted 4 days of additional annual leave in proportion to the attendance time. See all the conditions of employment and employee benefits·rice·s by clicking Employee benefits at the Clinique Cecile Cecil Hirslanden Clinique Cecil YOUR CANDIDATURE Alan Morel, HR Business Partner, is pleased to receive your complete application (motivation letter, curriculum vitae, copies of your diplomas and certificates). Please note that for data protection reasons, we cannot consider paper files (which will not be returned) or applications by e-mail. Therefore, please make your request exclusively online via this tool.
